REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - FEBRUARY 10, 2022 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS LINK: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87042987853
MEETING ID # 870 4298 7853
*THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER IS CLOSED FOR THIS MEETING. THE MEETING WILL BE CONDUCTED VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY* INSTRUCTIONS FOR PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN THIS MEETING ARE LISTED BELOW
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be closed to the public for this meeting. As authorized by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021), this meeting will be conducted via teleconference only. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using any of the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87042987853
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 870 4298 7853
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

Report from City Manager/Executive Director
During this part of the meeting the City Manager/Executive Director or designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior City Council meeting, including any request by the City Council to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior City Council meeting's agenda.
11B.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
12.

Closed Session Report
If the City Council adjourns to Closed Session, the City Council/Successor Agency will reconvene into Open Session after its conclusion and designated City staff will provide a verbal report on any reportable action taken. This report will be memorialized in the official meeting minutes.
13.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 10, 2022, 7:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCE MEETING
AUTHORIZED BY ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (CHAPTER 165, STATUTES OF 2021), VIA
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 870 4298 7853

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

5A.1. Informational update on Cerritos Community College given by Cerritos College President
  Dr. Jose Fierro.

  An informational update on Cerritos Community College was given by Cerritos College
  President, Dr. Jose Fierro. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

5B.  Informational update on the City's response to the COVID-19 pandemic and other City
  events, services, and programs.

  An informational update on the Tuesday, April 12, 2022 Cerritos General Municipal Election was
  given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Elections Official. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  An informational report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Audio public comments:

  Patricia Murray expressed concerns with the City’s at-large voting system and spoke
  regarding her campaign for election to the Cerritos City Council.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, February 10, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 2 of 5

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  Melissa Snyder expressed concerns regarding the Cerritos Girls Softball Association’s use of
  the City’s snack bar and City restrictions pertaining to cooking and warming food.

  Katherine (last name not provided) expressed concerns regarding the offerings and
  availability of the current City Adaptive Recreation Programs and the lack of accessible
  seating at the Festival of Friendship event.

  Jashbai Patel spoke regarding his support for Cerritos General Municipal Election candidate
  Sam Desai and expressed concern regarding City street repair and City finances.

  Sam Desai spoke regarding an upcoming meet and greet event and his campaign for
  election to the Cerritos City Council.

  Murali Vasudevan spoke regarding the upcoming Cerritos General Municipal Election and
  candidate appearances at City Council meetings.

  Dr. Graham expressed support for Cerritos General Municipal Election candidate Patricia
  Murray and her position regarding district-based elections.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor
  declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Thursday, January 27, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
  Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Vo, to approve the Thursday, January
  27, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated February 10, 2022 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Vo, to approve the Register of Demands
  as follows:

  City of Cerritos  February 10, 2022  $ 4,643,720.21 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, February 10, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 5

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  Waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING AND IMPLEMENTING TELECONFERENCE
  ACCESSIBILITY FOR CONDUCTING PUBLIC MEETINGS PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361
  (STATS. 2021, CH. 165) (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Vo, to waive full reading of and adopt
  Resolution No. 2022-13, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, AUTHORIZING AND IMPLEMENTING TELECONFERENCE
  ACCESSIBILITY FOR CONDUCTING PUBLIC MEETINGS PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY
  BILL 361 (STATS. 2021, CH. 165) (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of the City of Cerritos Annual Comprehensive Financial Report for
  Fiscal Year 2020-21 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Ryan Carey, Finance Manager and City Auditor, Daphnie Munoz.
  A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Audio public comments:

  Patricia Murray inquired as to whether or not the funds received from the American Rescue
  Plan Act were incorporated into the City’s General Fund.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor
  declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Yokoyama, and seconded by Hu, to receive and file the Fiscal
  Year 2020-21 City of Cerritos Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, February 10, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  Review and consideration of design concepts by Gary Alsum for the proposed public art
  project that will pay tribute to the Public Safety (Sheriff and Fire) Services. The project will
  be constructed at the north entrance area of the Cerritos Sheriff’s Station generally located
  on the northwest corner of Bloomfield Avenue and 183rd Street, west of the Cerritos City
  Hall (APN 7025-028-905) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kathy Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager, John Kinkade, the
  City’s design consultant, and Gary Alsum, the artist selected for the subject art piece. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Barrows, to approve the following:

  1. The two wall design concept provided by artist Gary Alsum and the design team of the
  National Sculptors Guild and appropriate $500,000 from the Art in Public Places Trust
  Fund for the acquisition of the art piece; and

  2. The K-9 standing design concept provided by artist Gary Alsum and the design team of
  the National Sculptors Guild and appropriate an expenditure of $91,000 from the Art in
  Public Places Trust Fund for the acquisition of the art piece; and

  3. The sculptural granite 9/11 Memorial Addendum to honor those lost in the September
  11, 2001 terrorist attacks, with the addition of the phrase “We will never forget,”
  provided by artist Gary Alsum and the design team of the National Sculptors Guild and
  appropriate $24,000 from the Art in Public Places Trust Fund for the acquisition of the
  art piece; and

  4. The Department Memorial pillar to honor those lost in the line of duty concept provided
  by artist Gary Alsum and the design team of the National Sculptors Guild, and
  appropriate $11,000 from the Art in Public Places Trust Fund for the acquisition of the
  art piece; and

  5. Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute the contract necessary to
  complete the scope of work, including any contract modifications (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, February 10, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 5 of 5

11.  Reports

11A.  Report from City Manager/Executive Director

  None.

11B.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports

  Reports were given by Councilmembers Barrows, Solanki, and Yokoyama, Mayor Pro Tem
  Chuong Vo, and Mayor Grace Hu.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned in memory of Pedro Benzon and Donna May Luke Simpson at 9:45
  p.m.

  /s/ Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary

  /s/ Grace Hu
